title: thyroma riedelii

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Thyroma riedelii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include lignans and alkaloids, that exhibit antimicrobial, antihistaminic, and antispasmodic activities.
